expected_error.message: t.when is the time column and holds text such as '02/01/2020', which does not say unambiguously what date it is: read day-first it is one date and month-first another, and nothing in the column says which. Convert it yourself so the reading is yours: frame['when'] = pd.to_datetime(frame['when'], dayfirst=True), or store it year-first

t.when is the time column and is written two ways: '2021-02-01' leads with its year and '01/02/2021' leads with its day or its month. No one reading covers both. The call that reads '01/02/2021' reads '2021-02-01' as a different date, so read the halves apart and put them back as one column, or store frame['when'] in one shape before naming it as the time column.
